scope: AI-only independent, read-only audit of all hold-editorial decisions for source ordinals 3552–4091. Evidence for editorial adjudication; not human approval or release clearance.
method: Verified 540 distinct source ordinals, exact sourceId and phrase identities, across nine 60-row provisional decision files.

Reviewed each of the 196 held occurrences with its exact source sentence and guide meaning against Golden SOP eligibility, naturalness, teaching-unit boundary, one-owner rule and same-sense requirement.

Compared five likely existing-owner aliases and two detector-risk cases against the current live canonical meaning and case-insensitive target regex; retained caveats when only the normalized core matched.
Classified each held row once. The classification is a triage opinion only; no decision, manifest, lesson or release file was changed.

priorityFindings.finding: Five likely same-sense existing-owner aliases have a detector match in their exact source sentence. For 3752, 3765, 3937 and 4021 the match is the normalized core, not the full marked phrase; editorial policy must decide whether this suffices.
The hold reason incorrectly says the 046 detector cannot catch separable “break them down”; it does. Task-versus-idea meaning scope still needs editorial adjudication.
The live 048 detector matches at once, but 048 teaches simultaneous and source 3985 means immediately. It must not be aliased to 048 based on detector alone.
Potential reusable natural-English expressions warrant editorial target/sense review; no lesson is approved by this report.
The conventional “falling through the cracks” subspan is embedded in a bespoke floor metaphor; avoid treating the entire marked sentence fragment as one idiom.
